objectives: Use the definite plural for specific things and people.
Choose object pronouns such as mig, dig, honom, henne and dem.
Give a calendar date with an ordinal number.

dialogue.title: A cinema invitation
dialogue.instructions: Listen for the date, time and Elin’s polite reply.

recall.prompt: When does Maja suggest the cinema?

dialogue.speaker: Maja
dialogue.fi: Hej Alex! Vill du gå på bio med mig?
dialogue.en: Hi Alex! Do you want to go to the cinema with me?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.fi: Ja, gärna! När vill du gå?
dialogue.en: Yes, gladly! When do you want to go?

dialogue.speaker: Maja
dialogue.fi: Den tjugofjärde maj. Filmen börjar klockan sju.
dialogue.en: On 24 May. The film starts at seven.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.fi: Bra. Ska vi fråga Elin också?
dialogue.en: Good. Shall we ask Elin too?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.fi: Hej Elin! Vill du gå på bio med oss den tjugofjärde?
dialogue.en: Hi Elin! Do you want to go to the cinema with us on the twenty-fourth?

dialogue.speaker: Elin
dialogue.fi: Tack för inbjudan, men jag kan inte. Jag ska träffa mina föräldrar.
dialogue.en: Thanks for the invitation, but I cannot. I am meeting my parents.

dialogue.speaker: Maja
dialogue.fi: Ingen fara. Vi frågar Henrik. Jag messar honom nu.
dialogue.en: No problem. We will ask Henrik. I will message him now.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.fi: Perfekt. Biljetterna är billiga på tisdagar.
dialogue.en: Perfect. The tickets are cheap on Tuesdays.

dialogue.speaker: Maja
dialogue.fi: Då köper jag biljetterna åt oss. Vi ses framför bion!
dialogue.en: Then I will buy the tickets for us. See you in front of the cinema!

lines.speaker: Berättare
lines.fi: Maria visar vad hon köpte när hon var ute med Nora.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.fi: Jag köpte nya löparskor till dig eftersom du måste motionera lite mer. Till Jonas köpte jag leksaksbilar för 99 euro. Nils fick två nya figurer som var på rea med 50 % rabatt.
lines.en: I bought you new running shoes because you need more exercise. I bought toy cars for Jonas. Nils got two figures on sale.

lines.speaker: Peter
lines.fi: Löparskorna är jättefina, tack så mycket! De passar mig perfekt. Men leksaksbilarna var lite dyra... Varför var figurerna på rea? Förresten, fick du mina meddelanden om Andreas?
lines.en: The running shoes are lovely and fit perfectly. But the toy cars were expensive. Why were the figures on sale? Did you get my messages about Andreas?

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.fi: De är gamla modeller så de var billigare. Det fanns många barn som ville ha dem. Ja, jag fick meddelandena och jag känner hans älskarinna.
lines.en: They are old models, so they were cheaper. Many children wanted them. Yes, I got the messages and know his mistress.

lines.speaker: Peter
lines.fi: Nähä! Barnen leker ute just nu, berätta!
lines.en: Really! The children are playing outside now; tell me!

sections.title: The specific things and people
body: Swedish adds an ending to mean “the” in plural. Groups 1–3 usually add -na: veckorna, bilarna, bananerna. Group 4 adds -a: mötena. Many group 5 nouns add -en: jobben and barnen.
Learn a noun with its plural. Then the definite plural becomes easier: en bil – bilar – bilarna.

examples.en: The cars are German and black.

examples.fi: Mötena är långa, men jobben är roliga.
examples.en: The meetings are long, but the jobs are fun.

sections.memoryTip: Most plural “the” forms end in -na. Watch mötena and jobben.
sections.tryIt: Say “the weeks, the bananas, the children”: veckorna, bananerna, barnen.

activity.label: Choose the ending
activity.title: Sort definite plural nouns
activity.instructions: Put each noun under its definite plural ending.

sections.title: Who receives the action?
body: A subject does the action: jag ringer. An object receives it: Sara ringer mig. Use mig, dig, honom, henne, oss, er and dem after verbs and prepositions.
De and dem are usually both pronounced dom, but formal writing keeps them separate: de act; someone sees dem.

examples.fi: Jag kan hjälpa dig. Kan du hjälpa mig?
examples.en: I can help you. Can you help me?
examples.note: dig and mig receive the action.

examples.fi: Vi väntar på honom och pratar med dem.
examples.en: We are waiting for him and talking with them.
examples.note: Use object forms after på and med.

sections.memoryTip: Ask: who does it, and who receives it?
sections.tryIt: Replace Sara in Jag ringer Sara with henne.

activity.label: Match the pairs
activity.title: Match subject and object forms
activity.instructions: Match each doer form to its receiver form, then say the pair.
activity.pattern: Sara ringer + object: Sara ringer mig.

sections.title: Order numbers and dates
body: An ordinal number says order: first, second, third. Dates use den plus the ordinal and month: den tredje juni.
The first forms need learning: första, andra, tredje, fjärde. Most later forms end in -de or -nde.

examples.fi: Jag fyller år den tionde maj.

activity.label: Build dates
activity.title: Match date numbers and spoken forms
activity.instructions: Match each written date to its ordinal.

sections.title: Invite, answer and suggest
body: Start with Vill du … med mig/oss? Accept with Ja, gärna! Decline kindly with Tack, men jag kan inte and give a short reason. Then suggest a date, time and meeting place.

examples.fi: Vill du gå på bio med mig den tjugofjärde?
examples.en: Do you want to go to the cinema with me on the twenty-fourth?

examples.fi: Tack, men jag kan inte då. Kan vi gå den tjugofemte?
examples.en: Thanks, but I cannot then. Can we go on the twenty-fifth?
examples.note: A polite no plus another suggestion.

sections.tryIt: Invite Elin and suggest one real date.

points: Give the date with an ordinal number.
Give a time and meeting place.
Ask whether the plan suits Leo.

assignment.title: Lecture 11 mission: A cinema invitation
assignment.instructions:
CORE: Invite someone to the cinema. Agree on a date, time and meeting place, and use an object pronoun.

WRITE: Send an invitation with a date and ask for a reply.

RETURN: Repeat the invitation from memory with a changed date.
assignment.model: Vill du gå på bio med mig? Kan vi gå den tjugofjärde maj? Filmen börjar klockan sju. Vi träffas framför bion. Passar det dig?

takeaways: Most definite plurals end in -na; learn the important patterns mötena and barnen.
Use mig, dig, honom, henne, oss, er and dem for the receiver of an action.
Say a date with den plus an ordinal: den tjugofjärde maj.
A useful invitation includes an answer, date, time and place.
